title: The usage text of backlog.py says only claim, done, new, start and close take --commit, but release now takes it too, and the kbtools entry for release names no --commit
goal: the usage block of _tools/backlog.py names release among the commands that take --commit [--trailer] and its subject list, and kbtools shows --commit in the release entry
repro_reason: the usage block is the module docstring, which no command prints whole; only its text can be read

run: import json,subprocess,sys;o=json.loads(subprocess.run([sys.executable,"_tools/kbtools.py","--json","release item to todo"],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout);t=next(e["answers"][0] for e in o["entries"] if e["tool"]=="backlog.py claim");i=t.find("release ID");print(t[i:i+40]);sys.exit(0 if i>=0 and "--commit" in t[i:i+40] else 1)
